text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Ines Fujin invited me to the amusement
park where she works part-time,
so I went to check in on how she was doing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, let's call out in a loud voice
for the hero of the amusement park, "Parkman"!
Ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Park Man!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Let me try calling out one more time!
Parkman—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait up for a sec, everyone!
Big sis is gonna go check out the situation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Did some kind of trouble happen...? I was worried, so I decided to go check on her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: T-The suit actor fell suddenly ill?!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
My stomach suddenly started hurting so I'm stuck in the bathroom...
I don't think it'll take that long,
but Ines-chan, could you stall for time somehow?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to do "something,"
the only things I can really do on stage are
the dances I practiced for the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But still, but still, that's completely different from a hero show, so... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a secoooond!
Ines-senpai, is it true that Parkman is in trouble!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nyah, Biko-chan!?
And Trainer too!
This area is authorized personnel only!
choice_data_list: I thought it was an emergency.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but...
Either way, we have to think about the stage!
We should really explain the situation to the audience—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Parkman is this amusement park's
hero... Bringing smiles to kids' faces
is his job, right!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yeah. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case!
We can't disappoint the kids who came to cheer for Park Man!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I see, everyone would be disappointed.
The little kids, the moms, the dads...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"They came all the way here as a family for fun,
so I don't want them to go home feeling sad.
I might not be a hero, but—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to entertain the audience on stage!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, how?
It's not a Winning Live, so
would my dancing really make people happy...?
choice_data_list: How about a dance styled like a hero show?
We should go with a dance that really brings out what makes you *you*, Aines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A hero show theme...!
That sounds like fun! You gotta help too, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! It's terrible!
Parkman is in huge trouble right now!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, help me...!
I've been captured by an enemy commander!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, everyone!
Let's send all our cheering spirits
to Parkman!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's all dance along with the big sisters!
I'm sure the power of dance will reach Parkman!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Parkman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Parkman! You're so strong!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, smile for me!
Your smiles are what give me strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin's dance got them through the emergency,
making the hero show a roaring success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What makes me, me... Yeah. Even I practice all the time just to make all my fans smile!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, watch closely, you two!
This is big sis Ines's grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“—Due to a minor schedule change,
we will now be presenting a mini dance show.”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Come on everyone, while we wait for Parkman to get ready,
sing and dance along with Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three!
One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...And turn here! All right, got it down?
Next, let's add the singing~!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
O-One, two, three...
And turn here... I did it—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Nice, nice!
Alright everyone, let's dance even better and give Parkman a big surprise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin's dance got them through the emergency,
making the hero show a roaring success.
